title: MICE to Meet You: From Re-ranking Only to End-to-End Retrieval
abstract: arXiv:2610.31932v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Late-interaction models offer state-of-the-art efficiency-effectiveness trade-offs for neural retrieval by enabling document representations to be pre-computed and efficiently indexed. Yet, their relatively simple interaction mechanisms, typically MaxSim, can limit their effectiveness compared to cross-encoders. MICE, a recently introduced re-ranking architecture, aims to combine cross-encoder-like effectiveness through expressive transformer-based scoring with reduced inference-time computation through document-side pre-computation. However, no practical way to store these document representations was explored. We address this limitation here and introduce MICE-P, the first end-to-end retrieval pipeline with MICE, based on PLAID to index the contextualized document token representations. translated_title: MICE很高兴见到你：从仅用于重排序到端到端检索
translated_abstract: 晚期交互模型通过允许预先计算文档表示并对其进行高效索引，为神经检索提供了最先进的效率与效果权衡。然而，其相对简单的交互机制（通常是MaxSim）使得其效果 compared to 交叉编码器有所受限。MICE是近期提出的一种重排序架构，旨在通过富有表现力的基于Transformer的评分获得类似交叉编码器的效果，同时借助文档侧预计算来降低推理时的计算开销。然而，此前并未探索出存储这些文档表示的实用方法。本文针对这一局限，提出了MICE-P——首个基于MICE的端到端检索管线，该管线基于PLAID对上下文化的文档token表示进行索引。我们通过使用Ettin Family在匹配的实验条件下训练可比模型，对MICE、ColBERT与交叉编码器进行了受控比较……
tldr: 本文提出MICE-P，首个基于MICE架构的端到端检索管线，通过PLAID索引上下文化的文档token表示，解决了MICE缺乏实用文档表示存储方案的局限，从而将MICE从仅能用于重排序扩展到完整的检索流程。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces MICE-P, the first end-to-end retrieval pipeline built on the MICE architecture, which leverages PLAID to index contextualized document token representations, addressing the lack of a practical way to store MICE document representations and extending MICE from re-ranking-only to full retrieval.
